# HR Pulse

> HR Pulse is an employee performance, evaluation, training, and reporting platform for HR teams, managers, and executives.

## Pages

- [Dashboard](/): Company performance overview with trends, branch and position comparisons, and top performers.
- [Evaluation](/evaluation): Run structured employee evaluations with scored criteria.
- [Employees](/employees): Browse employee directory and view individual performance profiles.
- [Training](/training): Manage training requests and coordination workflows.
- [Reports](/reports): Role-based HR reports for managers, HR branch leads, and executives.
